full_judgment:
3. In Writ Petition No. 964 of 1994 Petitioners Aliluddin and seven others challenged the impugned order dated 6-4-1994 (Annexure 'L' contending inter alia that a quantum of land measuring 5.61 acres appertaining to CS Khatian No. 21 corresponding to SA Khatian No. 30 ana CS Khatian No. 24 corresponding to SA Khatian No. 32 of Mouza Harirouth Pulker under Police Station Kaliakair, District Gazipur originally belonged to Raj Kishore Paul, his brother Joy Kishore Paul and Ray Kishore Paul, Hara Kishore Paul, and Ram Kishore Paul; that while in peaceful possession the aforesaid owners through a kabala dated 7-4-1972 transferred 1.40 acres of land to Kadarjan Bibi and by 3 (three) other kabalas on the same date sold 5.21 acres of land to petitioner Nos. 2-8. Thereafter Kadarjan Bibi through a kabala dated 15-6-1972 sold 0.85 acres of land to petitioner No. 1. Kadarjan Bibi died leaving behind petitioner No. 1 as her only heir and thus petitioner No. 1 inherited 0.55 acres of land and in the process became the owner of 1.49 acres of land; petitioner No. 1 possessed 1.30 acres of hind from plot No. 99 of SA Khatian No. 32 and 0.10 acres of land in ejmali with petitioner Nos. 2-8 from plot No. 94 of SA Khatian No. 30 by constructing house on 0.93 acres of land in plot No. 99. 

 While the petitioners were in peaceful possession of 5.61 acres of land in plot Nos. 64, 90, 99, 101, 103 of CS Khatian No. 24, Respondent No. 4 (the then Deputy Commissioner, Dhaka, now Gazipur) served a notice upon petitioner No. 1 under section 3 of the East Bengal (Emergency) Requisition of Property Act, 1948 notifying him that plot No. 94 measuring 1.48 acres of land of SA Khatian No. 30 and Plot No. 99 measuring 1.30 acres of land of SA Khatian No. 32 Mouza Harirouth Pulker under Police Station Kaliakair, District Gazipur have been requisitioned for installation of transmitter of Radio Bangladesh at Kabirpur vide LA Case No. 9 of 1973-74. 

 5. It is stated that after the aforesaid derequisition of 0.93 acres of land there remained 0.47 acres of land (0.37 acres in Plot No. 99 and 0.10 acres in plot No.94). Under requisition in LA Case No. 9/73-74 and in respect of other 4.21 acres of land of SA Khatian No. 30 and 32, no notice of requisition was served upon petitioner Nos. 2-8 who are the owners in possession of the aforesaid land and that being so the said land cannot be lawfully requisitioned. 

 10. In Writ, Petition No.1170 of 1994, petitioners Md Hafizuddin and 11 others contended that a quantum of land measuring 0.30 acres of Plot No.93/133; 49 acres of land of Plot No. 109 and 2.78 acres of land of Plot No. 108; L66 acres of land of Plot No. 9, 6.1.07: acres of land of Plot No. 97, 0.52 acres of land of Plot No. 103, 0.66 acres of land of plot No. 104 appertaining to Khatian No. 15 and 14.56 acres of land of plot No. 92; 0.28 acres of land of Plot No. 106 and 0.37 acres of land of plot No. 95 of Khatian No. 65 of Mouza Harirouth Pulker, within, PS Kaliakair, District, Dhaka now Gazipur belonged to Sreemati Hemangini Devi and Sree Shishir Mohan Chowdhury. Those two owners by 3 (three) separate kabalas transferred the property to Akbar Ali Pramanik, Bhasani Pramanik. Dr Abdul Hamid and Md Mulfat Ali. While in peaceful possession the aforesaid purchasers were served with notice under section 6 of the Emergency Requisition of Property Act, 1948, under the signature of the Deputy-Commissioner, Dhaka dated 10-2-75 informing them that 2.78, acres of land of plot Nos. 94, and 99, have been requisitioned in LA Case No. 9/73-74 for installation of Transmitter of Radio Bangladesh at Savar directing them to hand over possession of the aforesaid land to the Requiring body on or before 15-2-1975.
